title: UiPath second-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results
excerpt: Revenue increased 13% to $410 million, ARR increased 12% to $1.938 billion, and dollar-based net retention was 109%.
summary: The SEC-filed fiscal Q2 2027 release provides current revenue, ARR, retention, GAAP margins and profitability, cash flow, cash and securities, share count, stock compensation, leadership changes, product launches, and raised full-year guidance.
